visible_observation: The 'Reserve Tickets' button utilizes a solid white background with black text, while the rest of the interface relies on a dark, atmospheric palette with thin, translucent lines and low-contrast typography. Additionally, the button features a yellow underline accent that does not align with the yellow dashed circle in the artwork.
critique: The button acts as a visual anchor that is too heavy and opaque for the delicate, 'ghostly' aesthetic of the rest of the page. It breaks the immersive atmosphere by introducing a standard, high-contrast UI element that feels disconnected from the experimental, fragmented theme. The lack of alignment between the button's accent color and the artwork's accent color further fragments the visual language.
revision: Invert the button style to match the page's negative space: use a transparent background with a thin white border (1px) and white text. Change the yellow underline accent to match the exact stroke-width and color of the dashed circle in the artwork to unify the decorative elements.
protected_strength: The sophisticated, high-contrast typography of the exhibition title and the subtle, geometric complexity of the abstract artwork must remain untouched.
